build_pose_vae_pipeline: build a PoseVAEPipeline instance with a TrainConfig for training a pose VAE model
create_load_vae: create a PoseVAE model by calling load_vae on the PoseVAEPipeline instance
test_prepare_image: test prepare_image to concatenate ray origins and directions for VAE input
refactor_lpips_fn: refactor lpips_fn to compute separate LPIPS metrics for origins and directions channels
review_get_summary_image: review get_summary_image to generate a summary image combining input and predicted pose data
